name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted WhatsApp HTTP API with a web dashboard, Swagger docs and webhooks, storing sessions and media on persistent volumes.

alerts.message: After deploying, sign in to /dashboard with WAHA_DASHBOARD_USERNAME and WAHA_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD, enter WAHA_API_KEY, then start a session and scan its QR code with the WhatsApp app on your phone.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
